name: vibeshare
description: A decentralized file sharing and streaming network: client, content provider and search algorithm nodes.

scripts.build: npm run build:node && npm run build:gui
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json --noEmit && npm --prefix gui run typecheck
scripts.start: npm run build && node dist/cli.js client --open
